DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The imaging reveals multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts, which is the hallmark of this condition. Given your history of recurrent UTIs, visible hematuria, and negative nitrites on urinalysis, the diagnosis is consistent with stone formation secondary to medullary sponge kidney. No further tests are required.
